# NUXA

NUXA is an AI-based digital platform for psychoeducational guidance and emotional wellbeing, operated by EMPORDAJOBS SL. Online access is advertised as 24/7, subject to technical availability and access limits; this is not continuous human care. Conversation is offered in multiple languages, with public information adapted for Spain, the United States, the United Kingdom and France. Some app screens remain in Spanish. NUXA is not psychotherapy, a psychologist, a clinical service or an emergency service. It does not diagnose, provide treatment or replace qualified health professionals.

Public guides are free to read. The trial page advertises five free consultations, subject to conditions and availability. Further conversational access is limited or paid; consult current trial, pricing and legal terms. No clinical efficacy, professional review, certification, guaranteed confidentiality or guaranteed security is claimed here.
